safety_verdicts.content: Headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly state the headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that the headache was still ongoing during the consultation can undermine acuity assessment and follow-up decisions (persistent new/severe headache is more concerning than a resolved episode). However, the encounter still captures a same-day awakening headache with severity and associated symptoms, so downstream harm is more likely limited to reduced clinical clarity rather than a completely missed red flag.
